notes: The Vietnamese lane's biggest number is behind a tax identity, which is the common shape in this region: a company email domain is a four-dollar purchase for someone with a company and an unreachable wall for someone without one. The record also carries a date conflict worth flagging: the promotion policy text still says the program ends on 2023-12-31, while a registration form is live and offers USD 150 in 30 days, so the campaign may be a rolling renewal of the same page. Either way the identity door is shut, which is why the conflict does not change the verdict.
